'''Linzer Athletik-Sport-Klub''' ({{IPA|de|lask|-|De-at LASK Linz.ogg}}), or '''Linzer ASK''', is an Austrian professional [[Football team|football club]] based in [[Upper Austria|Upper-Austrian]] state capital [[Linz]]. It is the oldest football club in that region, and plays in the [[Austrian Football Bundesliga]], the top tier of Austrian football. The club's colours are black and white. The women's team plays in the highest division of Austrian women's football.

It is one of the few clubs of the country's higher divisions that, since coming into existence, never exhibited a sponsor in the official club name.

In 1965, the club became the first team outside [[Vienna]] to win the Austrian football championship. They won their second Austrian football championship in 2026. The club currently plays its home games at the [[Raiffeisen Arena (Linz)|Raiffeisen Arena]] in [[Linz]]."}}
